cost_reported: session time only: stage-1 sessions lasted a median of 6 (batch) to 9 (interactive) minutes; no $
evidence_notes: WSP is the whole study. Blind Claude Opus 5.5 sessions write Python over the CNN's weights at forward-pass budget 0 (open loop) and 10-50 (closed loop) (AGENTS.md; preprint). Preregistration was frozen at a private-repo commit tagged prereg-v1 on 2026-11-04, with 13 dated amendments, and tied to the release by commit hashes and SHA-256 (preregistration.md; VERIFICATION.md). That is internal, not a third-party registry. Design, harness, subjects and both coders used claude-opus-5-5 (results.md). Sessions rarely edited, only 2 of 36 met the fix criterion, and the MoDISco interpretability baseline fixed 6/18 k-mer cells (main.tex; results.md). The released Zenodo deposit contains code and the harness; weights and transcripts are withheld.
